keyFeatures: 64-question assessment that yields your 4-letter MBTI type (e.g., INFJ, ENTP)
Preference clarity scores showing how strongly you lean toward each dimension
Cognitive function stack revealing your dominant, auxiliary, tertiary, and inferior functions
Personalized strengths, weaknesses, and career suggestions based on your type
tips: Answer based on your natural tendencies rather than how you think you should behave — the most accurate results come from honest, instinctive responses.
After getting your type, explore the cognitive function stack to deepen your self-understanding beyond the 4-letter label.
